grade_rationale.text: Every surviving clause cites one source, Máchal's Slavic Mythology (1918); no other source remains in the entry.
Máchal records the spirit under separate names for the Slovaks, the Poles and the Slovenians in Styria.
The Czech reading rests only on the passage following Máchal's old Bohemian Setek; the skřítek sentence itself names no people.

Máchal says the spirit's memory still lives in popular tradition but cites no collection or informant in the passage; one compiler counts as one source, so four peoples do not make the entry regional or widely attested.
